closed_children.title: v0.3.1 P1: ARCH amendment for step records out of worktree

description:
Contract regression in v0.3 layout: step records (request.json,
response.json, tools/<tool-id>/{input,output}.json) live inside the
branch worktree, where the §3.5 / §5 principle "everything in the
worktree is conversation context" picks them up and the manifest's
worker.order: list explicitly stitches them into the wire request.

This double-feeds the model: the prior turn appears once in the
wire 'messages' history (where it belongs) and once embedded as a
file in context (where it doesn't). request.json is itself the
prior wire request; embedding it as context is circular. The
violation is structural — not a manifest tweak — because anything
in the worktree is fair game per the principle.

=== Fix ===

1. Step records relocate from <worktree>/steps/<conv-id>/<NNN>/ to
   <conv-repo>/steps/<conv-id>/<NNN>/, alongside manifest.yaml and
   the souls/ dir, outside every worktree.
2. Each step record gains a 'commit:' field referencing the branch
   tip at step start; the actual request payload is recoverable by
   replaying the assembler against that tree (steps records are a
   diagnostic / audit log, not load-bearing for replay).
3. response.json shape switches to JSONL of §4.4 stream events,
   written line-by-line during the call. Closed write fd is the
   completion signal (inotify-observable). UI tails it directly.
4. Snapshot-before-model-call (§2.10) simplifies: step 1's
   dispatch commit lands goal.md + soul.md only; step ≥2 has no
   pre-call commit (branch tip is already the model-read state).
5. template/manifest.yaml worker order: drops 'steps/**/request.json'
   and 'steps/**/response.json' — they were the redundant entries.
6. UI consequences: fs_watcher target moves to <conv-repo>/steps/;
   git_tree conversation detection switches from "steps/ paths in
   merge-commit diff" to the branch name (already encodes conv-id
   per §2.3).

=== Phases ===

P1: ARCH amendment (§2.2, §2.3, §2.10, §3.5, §4.4 on-disk shape, §5
    manifest scope). Docs-only land first per "amend docs, do not
    coin in code".
P2: Harness write-path relocation + snapshot-commit simplification
    + manifest scope trim. Existing harness tests rewritten.
P3: response.json -> JSONL stream + tail-write (writer-closes-fd
    completion). lernie prompt picks up streaming end-to-end.
P4: UI fs_watcher target + git_tree conversation-detection update
    against the new path.

=== Done-when ===

- All 4 phases closed.
- cargo test + tarpaulin --fail-under 100 green on main.
- Scratch lernie new produces a conv-repo where steps/ lives at
  the conv-repo root, not under root/.
- A scratch lernie prompt --stream against a stub adapter writes
  response.json as JSONL events line-by-line; the file is
  observably tail-able while the call is in flight.
- The terminal gates (tests, docs, alignment) close on this epic.

=== Out of scope ===

- v0.4 subagent dispatch (separate epic, blocked by v0.3 tools).
- v0.5 UI presentation work (bl-c0a5 phase children); they consume
  the new shape but ship in their own balls.
title: v0.3.1 contract regression: step records out of worktree
